verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that docs.kick.co/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index. The docs also provide .md mirrors on every page and a documented `?ask=` query interface that returns answers with sources, so an agent can be pointed straight at the docs. These are GitBook platform surfaces rather than Kick-authored agent docs, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: Kick-curated agent-oriented documentation beyond GitBook defaults, and a machine-readable API spec (all OpenAPI paths returned 404).
